author: XPSPACE
quote: This game has been overhyped by the media; it doesn't deserve all this popularity. After 13 years of waiting—for nothing—we get a game that runs at 30 fps and is riddled with technical issues. Two billion [dollars/units of currency] were poured into this project, yet I see no story or substance whatsoever, and the movement is incredibly sluggish. I wish reviewers would evaluate the game honestly rather than just following the media hype. We know it’s popular, but it certainly doesn't deserve a 99 [rating]. We waited for nothing; even a 90 is far too generous. We were expecting a result that would exceed all expectations.
